Country.evidence_source: Nepal in particular has a complicated and unclear purported suicide burden (Hagaman, Maharjan, and Kohrt 2016a).

Type.evidence_source: In this article, we (1) describe a novel mixed-method research approach for investigations into suicide (MPAC), (2) analyze thematically significant contextualized findings, and (3) outline their broad applications for the development of state and community level approaches to suicide prevention.

Area.evidence_source: LMIC scholars have argued that socio-political, environmental, and cultural factors may be just as important in the identification and prevention of suicide (Vijayakumar and Phillips 2016; Vijayakumar 2016).
